artwork.prompt: Album cover artwork, square format. A 2015-present sleeve. Medium: digital collage of cut-out photography over scanned paper texture. Subject: a stack of amplifiers. Palette: flash white, cheap yellow, dark green, exit-sign red. Composition: layered and deliberately flat, elements overlapping at odd scales. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
